newsitem.title: USA: Omega Healthcare files for $150 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Omega Healthcare files for $150 mln shelf.

text.p: Omega Healtcare Investors Inc said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $150 million in common and preferred stock, debt securities and securities warrants.
Net proceeds will be used for the repayment of short-term bank lines of credit and general corporate purposes, including additional investments in healthcare properties.

Omega, based in Ann Arbor, Mich., is a self-administered real estate investment trust which invests in income producing healthcare facilities, principally long-term care facilities, located primarily in the United States.
